title: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next NVFP4 on one RTX PRO 6000: SGLang-derived 'Pennyroyal' runtime
slug_note: Author-reported 171 tok/s single-stream decode and 524K context on one 96 GB card, using a personal fork of SGLang.

variation.quant_detail: RadixArk NVFP4 checkpoint; FP8 target/native-MTP KV cache (per post)

engine.config: SGLang-derived custom runtime 'Pennyroyal' v2.1.0: native NEXTN MTP, FlashInfer GDN/CUTLASS MoE, Triton QSA sparse prefill, RecoverSSM CUDA graphs; TP=1; YaRN factor-2 524,288 ctx; FP8 KV; HiCache/NIXL NVMe persistence

requirements.notes: Post does not state a memory requirement. Checkpoint is 135.3 GB on disk against 96 GB of VRAM, so the post's HiCache/NIXL host-RAM and NVMe paths are likely involved; not stated explicitly, not verified.

steps.text: Use the launch recipe in https://github.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000 (release pennyroyal-v2.1.0); the post links it but does not paste a command
Serve RadixArk/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 with TP=1 and a 450 W power cap

measurements.method: author's own campaign, TP=1, 450 W power cap (per post)
measurements.note: C1 decode, per the post's canonical single-GPU campaign

caveats: Author calls this a personal project, not a packaged product, and says Flash-Next 'remains early and system-specific'.
62,040.60 tok/s in the post is restored-prefix throughput after restart, not cold prefill, and is deliberately not recorded here.
Requires a custom SGLang fork; stock SGLang is not stated to work.

Checkpoint identity: the post says it serves 'the RadixArk NVFP4 checkpoint' but does not print the repo name. RadixArk/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 is the matching public repo (exists on Hugging Face, 135.3 GB), so size and licence come from it. This match is inferred, not stated by the author.

sources.note: NVIDIA developer forum post by jpezzulli, 2026-08-28; backs every figure in measurements.
